regions.name: Gallows Crossroads
regions.description: Four muddy roads meet beneath an empty gibbet. A lantern burns in the waystone, and no one remembers lighting it.
regions.arrival: You return to the Gallows Crossroads. The empty noose sways, though there is no wind.

regions.name: Ashen Marsh
regions.description: Fog, iron, and things that breathe under the water. Grey reeds crumble to soot at your touch.
regions.arrival: You trudge into the Ashen Marsh. The fog smells of iron.

regions.name: Whispering Pines
regions.description: Black pines lean close and murmur names. Some of them are yours.
regions.arrival: The pines close behind you. Something in the needles whispers your name, then laughs.

regions.name: Drowned Chapel
regions.description: A chapel sunk to its knees in black water. The bell still rings at midnight, from below.
regions.arrival: You wade into the Drowned Chapel. Cold water fills your boots like a grave fills with rain.

regions.name: Bone Quarry
regions.description: White terraces cut into the hill. The stone is not stone.
regions.arrival: You descend into the Bone Quarry. Every footstep crunches.

regions.name: Mire of Teeth
regions.description: A sucking bog studded with yellowed fangs the size of tombstones. Something regrows here.
regions.arrival: You step into the Mire of Teeth. The mud is warm, and it is moving.

regions.name: The Barrow Throne
regions.description: A hollow hill crowned with a throne of fused skulls. Its occupant has waited a thousand years for a worthy challenger.
regions.arrival: The barrow door grinds open. Pale fire kindles in empty sockets on the throne.
